items.title: Petkim Selects Univation's UNIPOL™ PE Process for a Planned Polyethylene Production Complex in Türkiye
items.summary: Univation Technologies announced that PETKIM PETROKIMYA HOLDING A.S. has selected Univation's UNIPOL™ PE Process Technology for a planned polyethylene production complex expected to be located in Aliaga-Izmir, Türkiye.
